name: Secret Society Member
source: Pathfinder Dark Archive (Remastered), Secret Society Member (pg. 80), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=60
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Dark Archive (Remastered) is ORC licensed material.
rules: Best for NPCs and other humanoids. Increase its level by 1; AC, attacks, DCs, Perception, saves and skills by 1; Strike damage by 1; HP by its starting level. Deception and Society become primary skills, Diplomacy or Intimidation primary and the other secondary; Connected, Shibboleth and two to three more abilities.
optional: Damage: only its Strikes deal 1 more. The rules also add 1 to the damage of its other offensive abilities (2 for ones it can use only a small number of times, such as a breath weapon): change those by hand.

choices.label: Primary skills extreme at 11th level and up
choices.note: Primary skills are high for the new level, secondary ones moderate (only ever raised).

choices.label: Abilities
choices.note: Two to three of these, as befit the secret society and their role in it.

abilities.name: Connected
abilities.description: {Name} has numerous connections, especially within the broad band of social class from which the society recruits, but stretching further through friendships, extortion, and other forms of influence. Whenever encountering a character from a settlement where the secret society has influence, {name} can attempt a Society check with an easy DC for the level of the encountered character if that character is a member of the demographic from which the secret society recruits, and a DC of hard or higher for other characters. On a success, {name} has a connection with that character they can use to ingratiate themself or push that character into acting the way they want. This grants a +2 circumstance bonus to Make an Impression, Coerce, Demoralize, or Request. On a critical success, the connection is especially strong or powerful and might even include a direct connection with the secret society, and the circumstance bonus increases to +4. {Name} can use this ability on a PC, though beyond Demoralize, the connection is more of a roleplay note informing their interactions with the PC.

abilities.name: Shibboleth
abilities.description: {Name} can communicate with other members of their secret society using coded language that seems innocuous enough to go unnoticed by most onlookers. A creature specifically gauging the conversation, such as with Sense Motive, can attempt a secret Perception check against {name}'s Deception DC to notice something secret has been communicated, after which they can attempt a Society check against the same DC. On a success, they discover the rough topic of the message; on a critical success, they discover the exact message.

abilities.name: Get out of Jail
abilities.description:
It's almost impossible to force {name} to face the consequences of their actions. Their society has fingers in the halls of law and justice, and where it can't sway the verdict, it can at least arrange the escape. When {name} would be brought to justice for their crimes, they attempt a Society check against a simple DC, depending on the severity of their crimes and the exposure of the evidence to the public (typically an expert simple DC of 20).
Critical Success Not only is {name} exonerated but they also manage to stay clean in the eyes of the public. Those who attempted to bring them to justice are called in for harassment, libel, filing frivolous charges, or other trumped-up indictments.
Success {Name} is declared not guilty and exonerated of their crimes in the eyes of the law.
Failure While {name} is initially declared guilty, they're released on a technicality, or manage to bribe or sneak their way out. While they're free, their reputation has been damaged.
Critical Failure Justice prevails, and {name} can't escape their sentence. Their society likely cuts ties with them and might turn to more dramatic means to ensure they can't expose the society.

abilities.name: Not Today!
abilities.description: Frequency once per day; Trigger {Name} is reduced to 0 Hit Points; Effect Whether it's a fellow society member waiting in the wings, a clever contraption, a contingent spell, or some other means, {name} always has an escape plan. Instead of being reduced to 0 Hit Points, {name} remains at 1 Hit Point, gains {=max(1, level)} temporary Hit Points and then Strides twice. If they have the appropriate forms of movement, they can instead choose to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim.

abilities.name: Prepared Diversion
abilities.description: Frequency once per hour; Effect {Name} has fellow members in all sorts of places, ready to make a distraction to help them duck from sight or make a quick attack against their foe. {Name} either Creates a Diversion or Feints. If they Create a Diversion, it doesn't gain the auditory, linguistic, or manipulate trait (since someone else has provided the diversion), and onlookers who have already been diverted by {name} don't receive a +4 circumstance bonus against the attempt. If they Feint, they don't need to be in melee reach of their target, and the benefit applies to both melee and ranged attacks against their target.

abilities.name: Prepared Trap
abilities.description: Frequency once per hour; Effect {Name}'s agents trapped the area in advance, and {name} arms one such snare. {Name} chooses an unoccupied space within 60 feet and activates a snare hidden there; the snare can be any common snare of level {=max(1, level - 2)} or lower. From this point on, creatures can trigger the snare as normal. During the activation, {name} must attempt a Deception check against the Perception DCs of creatures observing them; on a failure, those creatures realize where {name} activated the snare.

abilities.name: Tag Team
abilities.description: {Name} works best with other members of the same society. Any creature is off-guard against {name}'s melee attacks due to flanking as long as the enemy is within both {name}'s reach and the reach of one allied creature that is a member of the same secret society. Against a creature within the reach of two or more allied creatures that are members of the same secret society, {name}'s Strikes deal an additional 1d6 precision damage.
